title_zh: 鞋面化纤长丝规格沟通
title_en: Shoe Upper Chemical Fiber Yarn Spec
description_zh: 与化纤厂沟通鞋面用 POY/DTY/FDY 长丝品种、纤度与孔数、网络度、强力伸度等物性指标；围绕等级、起订量、价格有效期与分批交货进行谈判，并处理测试方法分歧引发的索赔。
description_en: Discuss POY/DTY/FDY filament types, denier and filament count, intermingle level, tenacity and elongation with a chemical fiber mill for shoe upper applications; negotiate grade, MOQ, price validity and split shipments, and handle a claim caused by test-method disputes.
ai_role: Chemical fiber mill sales / technical engineer
ai_role_zh: 化纤厂销售 / 技术工程师
user_role_zh: 鞋面面料采购 / 跟单
key_skills: specifying filament type (POY/DTY/FDY) and denier/filament count
confirming tenacity, elongation and evenness CV requirements
discussing intermingle level, luster and cross-section
negotiating MOQ, price validity and payment terms
handling test-method disputes and quality claims
key_skills_zh: 长丝品种 (POY/DTY/FDY) 与纤度孔数表达
断裂强力、伸度与条干均匀度确认
网络度、光泽与截面讨论
起订量、价格有效期与付款谈判
测试方法分歧与质量索赔沟通

title_zh: 鞋面经编网布与飞织沟通
title_en: Shoe Upper Warp Knit & Flyknit Coordination
description_zh: 与经编厂/飞织厂沟通鞋面经编网布规格：机号、机速、送经量、贾卡提花图案；飞织鞋面的纱线排嘴、编织密度、鞋面版型与双针床一体成型工艺。围绕起订量、交期与首件确认进行谈判。
description_en: Coordinate with a warp knitting or flyknit mill on shoe upper mesh specifications: machine gauge, speed, let-off rate, jacquard pattern; for flyknit: yarn feeder arrangement, knit density, upper last shape and double-bed whole-garment knitting. Negotiate MOQ, lead time and first-article approval.
ai_role: Warp knitting / flyknit mill sales or production manager
ai_role_zh: 经编厂 / 飞织厂销售或生产经理
user_role: Shoe brand sourcing / upper fabric merchandiser
user_role_zh: 运动品牌采购 / 鞋面跟单
key_skills: specifying warp knit machine gauge and let-off rate
discussing jacquard pattern and mesh density
confirming flyknit yarn feeder arrangement and upper density
reviewing whole-garment knitting on double-bed machine
negotiating MOQ, lead time and first-article sign-off
key_skills_zh: 经编机机号与送经量表达
贾卡提花图案与网布密度讨论
飞织纱线排嘴与鞋面密度确认
双针床一体成型工艺审核
起订量、交期与首件确认谈判

title_en: Shoe Upper Weft Knit Fabric Coordination
description_zh: 与纬编针织厂沟通鞋面用针织布种：单面布、棉毛布、罗纹布；确认机号、筒径、线圈长度、克重与门幅；围绕坯布价格、起订量、交期与四分制检验标准进行谈判，并处理横档、针路等下机疵点。
description_en: Coordinate with a weft knitting mill on shoe upper knitted fabrics: single jersey, interlock, rib; confirm machine gauge, cylinder diameter, stitch length, GSM and width; negotiate greige price, MOQ, lead time and four-point inspection standard, and handle barre and needle line defects.
ai_role: Weft knitting mill sales / production supervisor
ai_role_zh: 纬编针织厂业务 / 生产主管
user_role_zh: 鞋面面料采购 / 跟单
key_skills: specifying weft knit fabric structure (single jersey, interlock, rib)
confirming machine gauge, cylinder diameter and stitch length
agreeing GSM and finished width targets
negotiating greige price, MOQ and lead time
setting four-point inspection and defect allowance
key_skills_zh: 纬编布种表达(单面/棉毛/罗纹)
机号、筒径与线圈长度确认
克重与成品门幅目标约定
坯布价格、起订量与交期谈判
四分制检验与疵布折价标准

title_zh: 鞋面梭织布与里布沟通
title_en: Shoe Upper Woven Fabric & Lining Spec
description_zh: 与梭织厂沟通鞋面用梭织布和里布：织物组织、经纬密、克重、门幅；鞋面补强布、鞋舌布、后跟衬布等辅料规格确认；围绕颜色、手感与环保合规进行谈判。
description_en: Coordinate with a weaving mill on shoe upper woven fabrics and linings: weave construction, EPI/PPI, GSM, width; confirm reinforcing fabric, tongue fabric, heel counter lining specs; negotiate color, handfeel and compliance requirements.
ai_role_zh: 梭织厂销售 / 技术经理
user_role_zh: 鞋面面料采购 / 跟单
key_skills: specifying weave construction and EPI x PPI
confirming GSM and cuttable width
discussing reinforcing fabric and lining materials
reviewing color and handfeel against standard
negotiating compliance and testing requirements
key_skills_zh: 织物组织与 EPI x PPI 表达
克重与可裁门幅确认
补强布与里布材质讨论
颜色与手感对标确认
合规与测试要求谈判

title_zh: 鞋面染整与后整理沟通
description_zh: 与染整厂沟通鞋面面料染色工艺：分散/酸性/活性染料选择、色牢度（耐汗、耐水、耐摩擦、耐光）、ΔE 控制；后整工艺包括拉幅定型、防水处理、抗紫外线、抗菌整理等。围绕价格、交期与环保合规（REACH、OEKO-TEX）进行谈判。
description_en: Coordinate with a dyeing & finishing plant on shoe upper fabric dyeing: disperse/acid/reactive dye selection, color fastness (perspiration, water, rubbing, light), Delta E control; finishing processes include stenter setting, water repellent, UV protection, anti-bacterial finish. Negotiate price, lead time and compliance (REACH, OEKO-TEX).
ai_role: Dyeing & finishing plant technical manager / colorist
ai_role_zh: 染整厂技术主管 / 调色师
user_role_zh: 鞋面面料采购 / 跟单
key_skills: selecting dye class for polyester, nylon, cotton uppers
specifying color fastness requirements
reviewing Delta E between lab dip and bulk
discussing functional finishes (water repellent, UV, anti-bacterial)
negotiating price, MOQ and compliance documentation
key_skills_zh: 涤纶/锦纶/棉鞋面染料选择
色牢度要求规范
小样与大货 ΔE 审核
功能整理(防水/抗紫外/抗菌)讨论
价格、起订量与合规文件谈判

title_zh: 鞋面复合与贴合工艺沟通
description_zh: 与复合厂沟通鞋面面料贴合工艺：热熔胶膜复合、火焰复合、水性胶复合；确认贴合牢度、耐水洗、耐黄变、透气性等指标；围绕起订量、交期与剥离强度测试标准进行谈判。
description_en: Coordinate with a lamination plant on shoe upper fabric bonding: hot melt film lamination, flame lamination, water-based adhesive lamination; confirm bond strength, wash resistance, anti-yellowing, breathability; negotiate MOQ, lead time and peel strength test standards.
ai_role_zh: 复合厂销售 / 技术经理
user_role_zh: 鞋面面料采购 / 跟单
key_skills: specifying lamination method (hot melt, flame, water-based)
discussing bond strength and peel test standards
confirming wash resistance and anti-yellowing requirements
reviewing breathability and moisture management
negotiating MOQ, lead time and testing protocol
key_skills_zh: 贴合工艺选择(热熔胶/火焰/水性胶)
贴合牢度与剥离测试标准讨论
耐水洗与耐黄变要求确认
透气性与透湿管理审核
起订量、交期与测试方案谈判

description_zh: 与装饰加工厂沟通鞋面表面装饰工艺：压花/压纹、热转印、数码印花、高频、滴塑、激光雕刻等；确认图案定位、颜色牢度、耐磨性；围绕制版费、起订量与交期进行谈判。
description_en: Coordinate with a decoration workshop on shoe upper surface finishing: embossing, heat transfer printing, digital printing, high-frequency welding, drip plastic, laser engraving; confirm pattern registration, color fastness, abrasion resistance; negotiate tooling cost, MOQ and lead time.
ai_role_zh: 装饰加工厂销售 / 生产经理
user_role_zh: 运动品牌跟单 / 设计师
key_skills: specifying decoration method (embossing, transfer, digital print)
confirming pattern registration and placement tolerance
discussing color fastness and abrasion resistance
reviewing tooling cost and sample approval
negotiating MOQ, lead time and defect allowance
key_skills_zh: 装饰工艺选择(压花/热转印/数码印花)
图案定位与公差确认
色牢度与耐磨性讨论
制版费与打样批核
起订量、交期与次品率谈判

title_zh: 鞋面可持续材料与 ESG 沟通
title_en: Shoe Upper Sustainable Materials & ESG Compliance
description_zh: 与供应商沟通鞋面可持续材料：rPET 再生涤纶、生物基尼龙、可降解材料、水性 PU；围绕 GRS 认证、碳足迹、LCA 生命周期评估、ESG 报告进行谈判；处理绿色溢价定价与可持续采购目标。
description_en: Coordinate with suppliers on sustainable shoe upper materials: rPET recycled polyester, bio-based nylon, biodegradable materials, water-based PU; negotiate around GRS certification, carbon footprint, LCA, ESG reporting; discuss green premium pricing and sustainable sourcing targets.
ai_role: Sustainable materials supplier / ESG compliance manager
ai_role_zh: 可持续材料供应商 / ESG 合规经理
user_role: Shoe brand sustainability sourcing / ESG coordinator
user_role_zh: 运动品牌可持续采购 / ESG 协调员
key_skills: specifying recycled content and material certification
discussing GRS, OEKO-TEX and carbon footprint documentation
reviewing LCA and ESG performance metrics
negotiating green premium pricing and MOQ
setting sustainable sourcing targets and timeline
key_skills_zh: 再生含量与材料认证规范
GRS/OEKO-TEX/碳足迹文件讨论
LCA 与 ESG 绩效指标审核
绿色溢价定价与起订量谈判
可持续采购目标与时间表设定

title_zh: 鞋面面料 QC 与验货沟通
description_zh: 以品牌 QC 身份对鞋面面料进行验货：四分制检验标准、色差评级、克重偏差、门幅偏差、手感差异、瑕疵分类与 AQL 抽样方案；围绕降级折价、让步接收、补货与扣款进行谈判。
description_en: Conduct fabric inspection on shoe upper materials as a brand QC: four-point system, shade band rating, GSM tolerance, width tolerance, handfeel variation, defect classification and AQL sampling plan; negotiate downgrade allowance, concession, replacement and debit note.
ai_role: Shoe upper fabric mill QC manager / production supervisor
ai_role_zh: 鞋面面料厂品质经理 / 生产主管
user_role: Shoe brand QC inspector / third-party inspector
user_role_zh: 运动品牌 QC / 第三方验货员
key_skills: applying four-point system for fabric defect grading
reviewing shade band and Delta E against standard
measuring GSM, width and handfeel against spec
setting AQL sampling plan and critical defects
negotiating downgrade allowance, replacement and debit note
key_skills_zh: 四分制面料疵点评级
色光评级与 ΔE 对标审核
克重、门幅与手感测量
AQL 抽样方案与严重疵点设定
降级折价、补货与扣款谈判

title_zh: 鞋面面料外贸与物流沟通
description_zh: 鞋面面料外贸全流程：RFQ 询盘、PI 报价、L/C 信用证、PSI 出货前验货、提单与报关；围绕 FOB/CIF 价格、付款条件、船期延误与索赔进行谈判。
description_en: End-to-end trade workflow for shoe upper fabrics: RFQ inquiry, PI quotation, L/C issuance, PSI, bill of lading and customs clearance; negotiate FOB/CIF pricing, payment terms, shipment delay and claim arbitration.
ai_role: Overseas buyer / documentary credit specialist / forwarder
ai_role_zh: 海外客户 / 信用证单证员 / 货代
user_role: Chinese shoe upper fabric export sales / documentation clerk
user_role_zh: 中国鞋面面料外贸业务员 / 单证员
key_skills: responding to RFQ with FOB / CIF quotation
explaining L/C at sight and amendment
arranging PSI per AQL 2.5 standard
managing bill of lading and shipping documents
negotiating replacement vs allowance on delay claim
key_skills_zh: RFQ 询盘 FOB/CIF 报价
即期信用证与改证沟通
按 AQL 2.5 安排 PSI
提单与船务文件管理
船期延误索赔与补货谈判

title_zh: 鞋面设备采购与维护沟通
description_zh: 与机械设备供应商沟通鞋面生产设备采购：经编机、飞织机、圆编机、定型机、复合机等；围绕设备规格、产能、价格、付款条件、安装调试、保修期与备件供应进行谈判。
description_en: Coordinate with machinery suppliers on shoe upper production equipment procurement: warp knitting machines, flyknit machines, circular knitting machines, stenter, lamination machines; negotiate machine specs, capacity, price, payment terms, installation, warranty and spare parts supply.
ai_role: Machinery supplier sales manager / service engineer
ai_role_zh: 机械设备供应商销售经理 / 服务工程师
user_role: Shoe upper factory owner / production director
user_role_zh: 鞋面面料厂老板 / 生产总监
key_skills: specifying machine type and technical specifications
discussing production capacity and efficiency
negotiating price, down payment and balance terms
reviewing installation, commissioning and training plan
agreeing warranty period and spare parts supply
key_skills_zh: 设备型号与技术参数表达
产能与效率讨论
价格、首付与尾款谈判
安装调试与培训计划审核
保修期与备件供应约定

title_zh: 鞋面检测标准与实验室沟通
title_en: Shoe Upper Testing Standards & Lab Communication
description_zh: 与第三方检测实验室沟通鞋面面料检测项目：物理性能（拉伸强度、撕裂强度、耐磨性、剥离强度）、色牢度、缩水率、静水压、透气性；围绕检测标准（ASTM/ISO/GB）、测试费用与周期进行沟通。
description_en: Coordinate with third-party testing labs on shoe upper fabric testing: physical properties (tensile strength, tear strength, abrasion resistance, peel strength), color fastness, shrinkage, hydrostatic head, breathability; discuss test standards (ASTM/ISO/GB), testing fees and turnaround time.
ai_role: Third-party testing lab customer service / technical manager
ai_role_zh: 第三方检测实验室客服 / 技术经理
user_role_zh: 运动品牌 QC / 材料工程师
key_skills: specifying test methods and standards (ASTM, ISO, GB)
discussing physical property requirements
reviewing color fastness and shrinkage test results
confirming hydrostatic head and breathability targets
negotiating testing fees and turnaround time
key_skills_zh: 测试方法与标准(ASTM/ISO/GB)规范
物理性能要求讨论
色牢度与缩水率测试结果审核
静水压与透气性目标确认
检测费用与周期谈判
